items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: The bass fella used to play with Bob Lyon.

ctx.x: tromboneist. He left though wait before your time. I knew him in Chicago. I heard his records. I can't think of anybody else now to ask about the tromboneist that you might have heard.

The bass fella used to play with Bob Lyon. I know his name was Ernest. Is that the man they call Duck Ernest? Boy, he was a bass player. Duck Ernest. Another big fella. He used to play trombone. He used to play nice trombone. And we had another fella. He used to play by Al. By the name of Fawc Stein. He was a pretty good uh, uh, road team player. So if he ain't dead or he was playing yet in church. I don't know him. Yeah, he was.
What was his name again? Fawc Stein. Fawc Stein? Yeah.
